turns.user_utterance: What kind of cash machines would allow me to change my PIN?
turns.assistant_response: To confirm: are you asking how to change your card PIN using an ATM, or how to get/set a PIN for the first time? Also, which country are you in (so I can point you to the right ATMs)?

turns.user_utterance: I’m looking for ATMs where I can modify my PIN – I’m in the UK.
turns.assistant_response: In the UK, you can usually change your card PIN at an ATM that supports PIN change (often bank ATMs displaying “PIN Change”/“Change PIN” prompts). Try using ATMs from your card’s issuing bank network and follow the on-screen steps for “Change PIN.” If you tell me which bank/card you have (or the brand—Visa/Mastercard—and issuing bank name), I can suggest the most likely ATM types to use.
